hero.name: João Vitor Teixeira
hero.tagline: 2+ years building digital products end to end — React, Next.js, Node.js and advanced integrations, with an eye for performance and detail.

about.title: Building products from front to infra
about.bioLead: I'm a Full Stack developer with 2+ years of experience across startups, consultancies and high-complexity freelance projects.
about.bioBody: I've shipped complete end-to-end solutions — captive portals, real-time electoral survey tracking, dynamic forms, QR Codes and Instagram publishing automation. I work with React, Next.js, Angular and TypeScript on the front, Node.js, NestJS and Bun on the back, plus PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Docker. I have experience with advanced integrations (WhatsApp Business API, Twilio) and the optimized use of LLMs with prompt engineering. I always aim for clean code, good practices and real business impact.
